summary: A consent category is your definition of "approved" — without one, a privacy audit runs and reports nothing. We'll create one called "example.com — Approved". You add the tags and cookies you actually allow, because that list is a policy decision, not a technical one.

steps.say: Open Consent Categories in the sidebar, under Standards. If the sidebar is collapsed to icons, widen it first.

targetFallback.description: the "Consent Categories" link under Standards in the left sidebar
the create button on the Consent Categories page

steps.say: Choose "Create a New Consent Category" — the other two import from a template or OneTrust.

targetFallback.description: "Create a New Consent Category" in the open menu
the "Name" field on the consent category form

steps.say: Add the tags and cookies you approve of — that list is what "approved" means here.

targetFallback.description: the Next button in the consent category form

steps.say: Save it. Any audit can now attach this under Standards.

targetFallback.description: the Save button in the consent category form
